jobs.occupation: Senior Cloud Developer “SURU Connect” (f/m/d) (Bachelor Professional - IT (Softwareentwicklung))
jobs.description: Senior Cloud Developer “SURU Connect” (f/m/d)Are you ready to kickstart your career and take on a versatile role right from the start? To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Junior Accounting Specialist (m/f/d) at the earliest possible opportunity.As a Senior Cloud Developer, you will design, build, and operate cloud-native applications that are core toSURU Connect and SURU SignalHub.Working across the full solution lifecycle, you will turn customer and business needs into scalable, secure, andreliable digital products. Using C#, modern .NET, Blazor and AWS, you will take technical ownership whilehelping shape architecture, engineering practices, and the future direction of SURU´s connected water andIoT platforms.What You´ll Do:- Design, develop, test, and applications for SURU Connect and SURU SignalHub, including APIs,background services, data-processing pipelines, and modern** Blazor **web applications- Design reliable event-driven and distributed solutions on AWS using appropriate managed services,messaging, databases, and Infrastructure as Code. Integrate IoT devices, connectivity providers, externalplatforms, and customer systems, selecting the technologies andarchitectural patterns that best fit each usecase rather than being tied to a fixed stack- Work closely with product, business, customers, and external partners to identify valuable use cases andtranslate them into effective technical solutions. Own solutions from initial concept and architecture throughimplementation, deployment, monitoring, and production operation- Continuously improve reliability, scalability, security, observability, performance, and delivery automation.Contribute to architecture discussions, code reviews, technical standards, and knowledge sharing, while usingAI-assisted development tools and AI agents extensively for implementation, testing, debugging,documentation, quality assurance, and automatedsoftware deliveryWhat You´ll Bring:- 5+ years of professional software development experience, including substantial experience with cloud-based or distributed applications- Strong professional experience with C# and modern .NET, including ASP.NET Core, asynchronousprogramming, dependency injection, testing, and production-grade development- Strong practical experience with Blazor and the ability to build maintainable web applications within the.NET ecosystem- Solid understanding of software architecture, REST APIs, distributed systems, event-driven architectures,asynchronous processing, and messaging-based integrations- Practical experience designing and operating applications on AWS, including compute, storage,databases, messaging, security, and monitoring- Strong experience with PostgreSQL, SQL, data modelling, and Entity Framework Core- Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, containers, automated testing, observability, andproduction operations- Ability to work across the full application stack, from backend services and integrations to Blazor-baseduser interfaces- Ability to evaluate and adopt new cloud services, frameworks, development tools, and architecturalapproaches where they provide clear technical or business value- Strong practical experience with AI-assisted software development and coding agents, including AI-supported quality and delivery workflows- Strong problem-solving, communication, and technical ownership, with the ability to work proactivelywith customers, product stakeholders, and other engineering disciplines- Proficiency in both English and German (German at least B1)Nice to Have:- Experience with IoT platforms, smart metering, telemetry ingestion, MQTT, connected devices, orindustrial integrations- Experience designing highly observable and resilient distributed systems- An AWS certification such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified DeveloperWhat´s In It For You:- Small, agile teams where your work and voice have real impact- Direct influence on architecture and technical direction, with ownership across the full software lifecycle- Freedom to choose the right tools and work with modern cloud, IoT, and AI-assisted engineeringtechnologies- Support for attending conferences and continuing your professional developmentWhy Join SURU?A pipe-related water damage incident happens every 30 seconds in Germany alone. At SURU - part of LIXIL - you will build digital solutions that make water systems smarter and more reliable. SURU Connect turnssmart-metering data into useful insights, while SURU SignalHub connects devices, IoT platforms, connectivityproviders, and downstream applications. You will work across IoT, cloud infrastructure, data processing, andmodern web applications, with real influence over how our products evolve.Are we on the same wavelength? We are looking forward to your application!Ms. Nina AugschellerFeldmühleplatz 1540545 Düsseldorf

jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As Program Lead Finance (f/m/d), you lead the Finance transformation for Large Steam & Syncons (LSS) while serving as co-lead of the overall LSS rollout within Siemens Energy's global S4Energy program.In this project-driven Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business, you act as the key Finance & Controlling representative, ensuring that business requirements are translated into scalable SAP S/4HANA solutions. Working closely with Finance, Controlling, Manufacturing, and global program teams, you steer critical decisions across project controlling, product costing, manufacturing controlling, and financial closing.From shaping target processes and driving testing activities to coordinating cutover, go-live, and change management, you combine strategic leadership with hands-on execution to deliver a successful and sustainable business transformation.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead the Finance transformation and co-lead the S4Energy rollout for Large Steam & Syncons, ensuring alignment across stakeholders and program objectives* Drive end-to-end Finance implementation activities, including requirements management, process design, Fit-Gap workshops, testing, data migration, cutover, implementation success* Lead stakeholder engagement and change management initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and sustainable adoptionWhat You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's degree in transformation programs* Strong expertise in Record-to-Report, Project Controlling, Product Costing, Manufacturing Controlling, and Financial Closing* Solid understanding of Engineer-to-Order (ETO) business processes and end-to-end value flows across project execution and manufacturing* Excellent stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and leadership skills with experience aligning global cross-functional teams* Fluency in German and English, enabling effective collaboration in an international environmentAbout the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

The postdoc position will initially be embedded for one year in the internationally funded IMAGESTRO project. There is an option of extension for another year. jobs.description: In order to fill a fixed-term position in part-time (29.8725 hours/week = 75%) at the earliest possible date, we are looking for 1ERC PhD Position in Low-Dimensional Topology and Knot Theory (m/f/x)Our research group works in low-dimensional topology and knot theory. We are interested in link homology theories, such as Heegaard Floer and Khovanov homology, and their application to open topological problems. Our work is supported by a Starting Grant (project number 101115822) from the European Research Council (ERC).Scope: part-timeDuration: fixed-term, 3 yearsStart: at the earliest possible dateApply by:  2027-11-16Your tasks:- Conduct individual and collaborative research projects related to my ERC Starting Grant, "Cut-and-paste Conjectures and Multicurves", through which the position is funded.- Publish high-quality papers in peer-reviewed journals.- Disseminate research through talks at international workshops and conferences.- Organize and actively participate in research group seminars.- (Optional) Be involved in the supervision of graduate students.- Contribute to fostering a collegial, inclusive, and respectful working environment where everyone is treated fairly, with dignity and respect.Your profile:- (Essential) Excellent Bachelor's Degree- (Essential) An outstanding master's degree (proof must be provided by the start date)- (Essential) Good communication skills in either English or German.- (Desirable) Demonstrable ability to plan and manage independent research.- (Desirable) Track record of presenting research at conferences, symposia, or meetings, commensurate with stage of career.- (Desirable) Strong publication record in peer-reviewed journals, commensurate with stage of career.- (Not essential) Working knowledge of a programming language (e.g., Python, C, C++).https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/35b0dea75b524defb04df97ed0d425817d0cebd30?ref=AfA (https://jobs.ruhr-uni-bochum.de/jobposting/35b0dea75b524defb04df97ed0d425817d0cebd30?ref=AfA)

jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionAre you passionate about shaping the legal framework of sustainability and responsible business practices?As Senior Legal Counsel ESG Law, you will provide highly specialized legal advice on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) matters and support the effective integration of Boehringer Ingelheim's SD4G framework.By translating evolving legal and regulatory requirements into practical guidance, you will enable strategic ESG initiatives across the organization and advise on Social Engagement projects, including those with proximity to venture capital mechanisms.Tasks & responsibilities- Provide strategic legal counsel on ESG-related legal and regulatory requirements, enabling Boehringer Ingelheim to advance its sustainability and social responsibility ambitions in a compliant and future-oriented manner.- Shape the legal interpretation of emerging ESG regulations, including current and upcoming frameworks such as the EU Taxonomy and Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD), the EU Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD), the EU Empowering Consumers Directive (Green Claims), as well as product compliance related frameworks such as the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation and translate requirements into actionable business guidance and contractual clauses.- Act as the trusted Legal Business Partner for the Corporate Sustainability team and serve as the central legal contact for the global coordination of SD4G-related matters across Global Legal and Compliance.- Drive the development of pragmatic legal solutions that support reporting obligations, corporate governance requirements, and organizational structures across national and international jurisdictions.- Support impactful sustainability and social engagement initiatives together with the Boehringer Ingelheim Venture Fund legal team by advising on legal risks and opportunities and by structuring, drafting, and negotiating agreements, including transaction, loan, cooperation, and sponsorship contracts.- Represent the Global Legal & Compliance function in relevant committees, steering groups, and external peer networks, fostering collaboration and bringing legal ESG perspectives into strategic discussions.Requirements- Fully qualified lawyer (or equivalent legal qualification), with long-term experience in a leading law firm and/or as in-house counsel in an international environment- Deep expertise in ESG law, including comprehensive knowledge of existing and emerging regulatory frameworks such as the CSRD, and CSDDD- Strong strategic and commercial acumen, ideally gained within the pharmaceutical industry or another highly regulated sector- Proven ability to provide strategic legal advice on ESG matters and to support the implementation of evolving sustainability and social responsibility requirements- Broad experience handling ESG-related legal matters, including contract drafting, review and negotiation, as well as transaction-related agreements and other complex commercial arrangements- Strong analytical and strategic thinking with a long-term focus, able to communicate risk, exercise sound judgment under ambiguity and simplify complex matters for all levels of the organization- Business-oriented mindset and excellent stakeholder management skills in cross-functional and international settings, combined with strong communication skills in EnglishAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.comReady to contact us?If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.comRecruitment process:Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until November 15, 2026.
